intended_capability: Read a public repository from the local shell using Git transport
observed_failure: DNS lookup for github.com returned no addresses. Git clone and git ls-remote both failed with Could not resolve host: github.com. The connected GitHub repository tool could still read repository files.
tests: getent ahosts github.com: exit 2, no address output
git ls-remote: exit 128, Could not resolve host: github.com
workaround: Use the repository connector for supported reads and writes, then GitHub Actions for execution. Do not bypass the local network boundary.
residual_risk: The root cause is unknown; connector operations are narrower than a shell and CI runs in a separate environment.
next_experiment: Run CI against this report and regression tests; use an approved environment with documented network access if local Git transport is required.
